name: Ephesians
author: The apostle Paul. Some scholars question this, though the church has long affirmed Pauline authorship.
date: Usually dated about AD 60 to 62, from prison.
setting: Written to believers in Ephesus and perhaps nearby churches.
theme: God has united Jew and Gentile in Christ, and calls the church to live worthy of that calling.

outline.label: What God has done in Christ
The old self and the new

christInBook: Paul says that all things are summed up in Christ (1:10), that Christ is the cornerstone of the household of God (2:20), and that the church is his body and his bride (5:25-32).
howToRead: Ephesians has two halves: what God has done (chapters 1 to 3) and how we then live (chapters 4 to 6). Watch for the repeated phrase “in Christ” and for the long sentences, especially in chapter 1.
